units.source_text: 外祖母的丧服是三个月。

en.t: The mourning period for her maternal grandmother was three months.

units.source_text: 到了除日，紫姬丧服已满，可以改装了。

en.t: When the day of release from mourning arrived, Lady Murasaki had completed her mourning period and could change her attire.

units.source_text: 但她没有母亲，全赖外祖母一手抚育长大，因此丧服应该加重：

en.t: But she had no mother and had been raised entirely by her maternal grandmother, so her mourning ought to be made more solemn:

units.source_text: 凡金碧辉煌的衣服，一概不穿，

en.t: She wore none of the splendid, glittering garments at all,

units.source_text: 只穿红色、紫色、棣棠色等没有花纹的衫子，

en.t: wearing only unpatterned robes in red, purple, yellow rose, and similar colors,
which were elegant, fashionable, and extremely charming.
